an5.50:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Nārado Pāṭaliputte viharati Kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Muṇḍassa rañño Bhaddā devī kālakatā hoti piyā manāpā.
an5.50:1.3: So Bhaddāya deviyā piyāpāyena neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:1.5: Atha kho Muṇḍo rājā Piyakaṃ kosārakkhaṃ āmantesi
an5.50:1.6: ‘tena hi samma Piyaka Bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjatha, yathā mayaṃ Bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmā' ti.
an5.50:1.7: ‘Evaṃ devā' ti kho Piyako kosārakkho Muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā Bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujji.
an5.50:2.1: Atha kho Piyakassa kosārakkhassa etad ahosi
an5.50:2.2: ‘imassa kho Muṇḍassa rañño Bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā.
an5.50:2.3: So Bhaddāya deviyā piyāpāyena neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:2.5: Kin nu kho Muṇḍo rājā samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyya, yassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā' ti?
an5.50:3.1: Atha kho Piyakassa kosārakkhassa etad ahosi
an5.50:3.2: ‘ayaṃ kho āyasmā Nārado Pāṭaliputte viharati Kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:3.3: Taṃ kho pan' āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an5.50:3.4: "paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c'eva arahā ca."
an5.50:3.5: Yan nūna Muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ payirupāseyya, app'eva nāma Muṇḍo rājā āyasmato Nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā' ti.
an5.50:4.1: Atha kho Piyako kosārakkho yena Muṇḍo rājā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.50:4.2: ‘Ayaṃ kho deva āyasmā Nārado Pāṭaliputte viharati Kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:4.3: Taṃ kho pan' āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an5.50:4.4: "paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c'eva arahā ca."
an5.50:4.5: Yadi pana devo āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ payirupāseyya, app'eva nāma devo āyasmato Nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā' ti.
an5.50:4.6: ‘Tena hi samma Piyaka āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ paṭivedehi.
an5.50:4.7: Kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā' ti?
an5.50:4.8: ‘Evaṃ devā' ti kho Piyako kosārakkho Muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā yen' āyasmā Nārado ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Piyako kosārakkho āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.50:5.1: ‘Imassa bhante Muṇḍassa rañño Bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā.
an5.50:5.2: So Bhaddāya deviyā piyāpāyena neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:5.4: Sādhu bhante āyasmā Nārado Muṇḍassa rañño tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā Muṇḍo rājā āyasmato Nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyā' ti.
an5.50:5.5: ‘Yassa dāni Piyaka Muṇḍo rājā kālaṃ maññatī' ti.
an5.50:6.1: Atha kho Piyako kosārakkho uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena Muṇḍo rājā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.50:6.3: Yassa dāni devo kālaṃ maññatī' ti.
an5.50:6.4: ‘Tena hi samma Piyaka bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpehī' ti.
an5.50:6.5: ‘Evaṃ devā' ti kho Piyako kosārakkho Muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā Muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:
an5.50:6.6: ‘yuttāni kho te deva bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni.
an5.50:6.7: Yassa dāni devo kālaṃ maññatī' ti. 2.
an5.50:7.1: Atha kho Muṇḍo rājā bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi yena Kukkuṭārāmo tena pāyāsi mahaccarājānubhāvena āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ dassanāya.
an5.50:7.2: Yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko 'va ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
an5.50:7.3: Atha kho Muṇḍo rājā yen' āyasmā Nārado ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ āyasmā Nārado etad avoca: --
an5.50:8.1: Pañc' imāni mahārāja alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brāhmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.50:8.3: Jarādhammaṃ mā jīrī ti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ,
an5.50:8.4: vyādhidhammaṃ mā vyādhīyī ti . . . maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyī ti . . . khayadhammaṃ mā khīyī ti . . . nassanadhammaṃ mā nassī ti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ. 4.
an5.50:9.2: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.50:9.3: ‘na kho mayh' ev' ekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati,
an5.50:9.4: ahañ c'eva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattam pi me na cchādeyya, kāye pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kammantā pi na ppavatteyyuṃ, amittā pi attamanā assu, mittā pi dummanā assū' ti.
an5.50:9.5: So jarādhamme jiṇṇe socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:9.7: assutavā puthujjano. Viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti. 5.
an5.50:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja assutavato puthujjanassa vyādhidhammaṃ vyādhīyati . . . maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati . . . khayadhammaṃ khīyati . . . nassanadhammaṃ nassati,
an5.50:10.2: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.50:10.3: ‘na kho mayh' ev' ekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati,
an5.50:10.4: ahañ c'eva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattam pi me na cchādeyya, kāye pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kammantā pi na ppavatteyyuṃ, amittā pi attamanā assu, mittā pi dummanā assū' ti.
an5.50:10.5: So nassanadhamme naṭṭhe socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:10.7: assutavā puthujjano. Viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti. 6.
an5.50:11.1: Sutavato ca kho mahārāja ariyasāvakassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati,
an5.50:11.3: ‘na kho mayh' ev' ekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati,
an5.50:11.4: ahañ c'eva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattam pi me na cchādeyya, kāye pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kammantā pi na ppavatteyyuṃ, amittā pi attamanā assu, mittā pi dummanā assū' ti.
an5.50:11.5: So jarādhamme jiṇṇe na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:11.7: sutavā ariyasāvako. Abbuhi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:11.8: Asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpeti. 7.
an5.50:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sutavato ariyasāvakassa vyādhidhammaṃ vyādhīyati . . . maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati . . . khayadhammaṃ khīyati . . . nassanadhammaṃ nassati,
an5.50:12.3: ‘na kho mayh' ev' ekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati,
an5.50:12.4: ahañ c'eva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattam pi me na cchādeyya, kāye pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kammantā pi na ppavatteyyuṃ, amittā pi attamanā assu, mittā pi dummanā assū' ti.
an5.50:12.5: So nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.50:12.7: sutavā ariyasāvako. Abbuhi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:12.8: Asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpeti.
an5.50:13.1: Imāni kho mahārāja pañca alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin ti.
an5.50:14.2: attho idha labbhā api appako pi,
an5.50:17.2: mayā vā aññena vā esa attho',
an5.50:18.1: Evaṃ vutte Muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāradaṃ etad avoca
an5.50:18.2: ‘ko nu kho ayaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo' ti?
an5.50:18.5: taggha bhante sokasallaharaṇo, imaṃ hi me bhante dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pahīnan' ti.
an5.50:19.1: Atha kho Muṇḍo rājā Piyakaṃ kosārakkhaṃ āmantesi
an5.50:19.2: ‘tena hi samma Piyaka Bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ jhāpetha thūpañ c' assā karotha.
an5.50:19.3: Ajja-t-agge dāni mayaṃ nhāyissāma c'eva vilimpissāma bhattaṃ bhuñjissāma kammante ca payojessāmā' ti.
